title: Keyboard shortcuts
intro: These work wherever their screen is open. Shortcuts with a single key do nothing while you type in a field.

action.drawer: Expand or collapse the panel (assistant, terminal, events, logs, problems); nothing stops
action.close: Close the topmost layer: menu, dialog, collapse the panel while focus is in it (not inside a terminal; inside the task assistant Esc stops it, then collapses the panel), inspector, then full screen
action.submit: Submit the composer, approve the focused crew, send a message or comment
action.assistant: Expand the panel on the task assistant, or collapse it while the assistant keeps running
action.assistant.send: Send your message to the task assistant (Shift Enter adds a line)
action.assistant.prev: In the task assistant's conversation: the previous message, whose actions Tab then reaches
action.assistant.next: In the task assistant's conversation: the next message
action.graph.menu: Open the menu of the focused node
action.graph.move: Move the focused node by one grid step
action.panel.terminal: Expand the panel on the terminal, or collapse it
action.panel.problems: Expand the panel on problems, or collapse it
action.terminal.close: On a terminal's tab: end its shell (asks while it runs)
action.terminal.leave: Inside a terminal: move focus back to its tab (Tab goes to the shell)
